one_line_thesis: Ecora is a London and Toronto royalty company.

deep_dive.executive_summary: Ecora is a London and Toronto royalty company. The 2025 accounts are in US dollars. Kestrel is still material and is guided to end in 2030. Base metals were half of portfolio contribution. Company free cash flow was $27.4 million after interest, on 248.944 million weighted average shares. The plain owner-cash path, with no growth and a 12 times sale in year 7, is about 0.6% per year. The valuation file's base case, after the engine blend, is 2.01% per year. That is not a buy on the reported cash. Stance is watch. The ending share count was not in the results release, so the per-share figure...
